description.tr: Crewhall panolarını Azure DevOps work item'larıyla iki yönlü eşitler: başlık, açıklama, durum, atanan, öncelik, tarih, etiket, puan ve yorumlar. Azure Pipelines'ı izler ve çalıştırır, Library değişken gruplarını yönetir. Bana atanan işler, sohbet komutu ve asistan araçları içerir. Kişisel erişim token'ı (PAT) ya da Entra ID ile bağlanır.
description.en: Keeps Crewhall boards in two-way sync with Azure DevOps work items: title, description, status, assignee, priority, dates, labels, points and comments. Watches and runs Azure Pipelines and manages Library variable groups. Includes your assigned work, a chat command and assistant tools. Connects with a personal access token (PAT) or Entra ID.

description.tr: Azure DevOps work item'ını sohbete getir: /is 123 ya da /is ara giriş hatası
description.en: Bring an Azure DevOps work item to the chat: /is 123 or /is ara login bug

description.tr: Azure DevOps projesindeki son koşuları göster: /pipeline Web
description.en: Show the latest runs of an Azure DevOps project: /pipeline Web

tools.name: search_work_items
tools.description: Searches the caller's connected Azure DevOps work items by text. Read only.

tools.name: my_work_items
tools.description: Lists open Azure DevOps work items assigned to the caller. Read only.

tools.name: add_work_item_comment
tools.description: Adds a comment to an Azure DevOps work item the caller can reach.

tools.name: list_pipelines
tools.description: Lists an Azure DevOps project's pipelines with their latest result. Read only.

tools.name: run_pipeline
tools.description: Starts an Azure DevOps pipeline on a branch.
